high_level_description: The image features a circular portrait of an older man with white hair and a beard, wearing a light blue shirt. The background behind the portrait is a solid blue color. Below the portrait, there is a handwritten note that reads: "Dear Solitaire lovers, I am 110 years old and I play solitaire everyday to get better sleep and prevent memory loss. I recommend to play classic solitaire. This game is designed exclusively for our seniors." A hand holding a red pen is seen writing the last part of the note, which is partially cut off.
